tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Alternate page bands, sidebars.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Modals, popovers, toasts (pair with a shadow).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, code blocks, track of sliders/progress.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, menu items, ghost buttons.

tokens.name: surface-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for rows, menu items, ghost buttons.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltips, snackbars — the inverted surface.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card outlines (not for controls).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and radio borders — ≥3:1 on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-raised (18.9:1 light, 17:1 dark).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, helper text, captions on bg/surface (≥6.7:1).

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, metadata on bg/surface (≥4.5:1). Not for body copy.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only (exempt from contrast).

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse and on action.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Default icon colour.

tokens.name: icon-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary icons (≥3:1 needed, has 6.7:1).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, selected states, switch on, checkbox checked. Brand slot: light reads primary-950.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on action fills.

tokens.name: action-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed on action fills.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text/icons on action fills.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline with a 2px offset in bg colour — ≥3:1 against every surface.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links are ink + underline; never colour alone.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals and drawers.

tokens.name: danger

styles.name: label

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: No space.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Base unit. Gap between related items; icon-to-label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding; compact list rows.

tokens.name: space-16

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Card padding (desktop); gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Section padding inside pages; modal padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-40

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections (desktop).

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Hero padding; large layout gutters.

tokens.name: space-80
tokens.usage: Marketing section rhythm.

tokens.name: space-96

tokens.name: space-128
tokens.usage: Maximum layout spacing.
